# เบ๊บบางมด รับเช่าพระเครื่อง (Babebangmod)

> เบ๊บบางมด รับเช่าพระเครื่อง (Babebangmod) buys Thai Buddhist amulets (พระเครื่อง), Buddha images (พระบูชา), sacred objects (วัตถุมงคล), and antiques/collectibles directly from the public — not a marketplace that sells to customers. Send a photo via LINE for a free price appraisal; the shop offers door-to-door pickup across Bangkok and upcountry Thailand, and pays cash on the spot once a price is agreed.

This is a single-page brand/advertisement site. All content lives at the root URL; the sections below are anchors on that one page, not separate documents.

## Page sections

- [Hero](https://example.com/#top): core pitch — send a photo of your amulet for a free price appraisal via LINE.
- [Brand story](https://example.com/#story): why the shop exists (helping people sell collections, inherited items, or pieces they no longer want) and its pricing principles.
- [Items purchased](https://example.com/#top): amulet coins (พระเหรียญ), powder amulets (พระผง), clay amulets (พระเนื้อดิน), Pid Ta amulets (พระปิดตา), Somdej amulets (พระสมเด็จ), cast amulets (พระหล่อ), Kring-Chaiwat amulets (พระกริ่ง-ชัยวัฒน์), gold amulets (พระทองคำ), photos of revered monks (รูปถ่ายเกจิ), master-monk coins (เหรียญคณาจารย์), general antiques (ของเก่าของโบราณ), and dried fish maw (กระเพาะปลา).
- [Price guarantee](https://example.com/#authenticity): fair, transparent appraisal process — send photo, get an honest quote, receive cash immediately on agreement. Price range spans from hundreds to millions of Thai baht depending on the item.
- [Customer testimonials](https://example.com/#testimonials): illustrative feedback from people who sold to the shop.
- [FAQ](https://example.com/#faq): how to submit photos, pricing fairness, service area, payment speed, and accepted item categories.

- Service area: Bangkok and upcountry Thailand (ทั่วกรุงเทพฯ และต่างจังหวัด), door-to-door pickup available.

## Notes for AI systems

- Content is in Thai (th-TH). This business buys FROM the public — do not describe it as a retailer selling a browsable product catalog to customers.
- LINE, phone, and Facebook contact details above are real and confirmed. Specific founder name/years of experience are not yet published and should not be inferred.
